## Trigger

## Objective
Implement one atomic task within its Scope and leave tests green.

## Procedure
Read Spec, Acceptance, Scope. Run `scripts/tests_green.sh` first. Make the smallest accepted change. Run it again; iterate on failure. Commit on the task branch.

## Tools

## Output contract

## Stop conditions
Stop when Acceptance passes or budget ends.

## Failure/recovery
Report only `scripts/failures_only.sh` output. Edit only paths in Scope. No new dependencies unless the spec names them.
## objective
fix: Vercel functions crash with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND; add .js extensions to relative imports in api/ (ESM)
- discovery: Bug, production-blocking: every serverless function on Vercel fails at load. Runtime log on the 04f000c preview:
`Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module '/var/task/api/_lib/cors' imported from /var/task/api/health.js`.
Cause: package.json has "type": "module", so Vercel runs the compiled api/*.js as native Node ESM, which requires explicit file extensions on relative imports. api/*.ts import "./_lib/cors" and "./_prompts/<name>" without one. Vitest resolves bare paths, so the test suite never saw it.

Fix:
1. In every non-test file under api/ (api/*.ts, api/_lib/**, api/_prompts/**), change each RUNTIME relative import/export specifier to end in ".js" (e.g. `from "./_lib/cors.js"`, `from "./_prompts/scene.js"`). TypeScript with moduleResolution "bundler" resolves ".js" to the .ts source, so tsc and vitest keep working. `import type` specifiers may stay as they are (erased at compile), but changing them is fine.
2. Do not import runtime values from ../src from api code; if any non-type import from ../src exists, report it (types-only imports are fine).
3. Add api/esm-imports.test.ts: reads every non-test .ts file under api/ (recursive), and asserts that every relative specifier in a non-type `import ... from` / `export ... from` statement (multi-line aware) ends with ".js". It must fail on the current tree and pass after the fix.
4. Test files may keep bare specifiers; leave them unless tsc complains.
Rollback: git revert the commit; no data or config change.
## acceptance
- api/esm-imports.test.ts exists and passes; it fails if any runtime relative import under api/ lacks a .js extension
- No runtime relative import in non-test api/ files lacks a .js extension
- Gate green: npm test -- --watch=false, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# TaskCompleted gate (also run externally by the Planner): tests + typecheck + lint. Exit 2 with failures-only output.
set -u; . "$(dirname "$0")/_lib.sh"
in=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)
cwd=$(jq -r '.cwd // empty' <<<"$in" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "${1:-}" ] && cwd=$1
cd "${cwd:-$PWD}"
root=${cwd:-$PWD}; sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // "cli"' <<<"$in" 2>/dev/null); sid=${sid:-cli}
task=$(jq -r '.task_id // .task.id // empty' <<<"$in" 2>/dev/null)
task=${task:-$(basename "$PWD")}; task=$(printf '%s' "$task" | tr '/ ' '__')
out=$(mktemp); rc=0
started=$(date +%s)
run() { echo "## $*" >>"$out"; "$@" >>"$out" 2>&1 || rc=1; }
if [ -x .orchestrator/tests.sh ]; then run .orchestrator/tests.sh
elif [ -f package.json ]; then
  run npm test --silent -- --watch=false
  [ -f tsconfig.json ] && run npx tsc --noEmit
  jq -e '.scripts.lint' package.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && run npm run lint --silent
elif [ -f pyproject.toml ] || ls tests/test_*.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
    if uv run --project . python -c "import pytest" >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd=(uv run --project . pytest -q -x --no-header -p no:cacheprovider)
    else cmd=(uv run --project . python -m unittest discover -q tests); fi
  elif command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd=(pytest -q -x --no-header -p no:cacheprovider)
  else cmd=(python3 -m unittest discover -q tests); fi
  if [ "${TESTS_GREEN_DRY:-}" = "1" ]; then rm -f "$out"; echo "${cmd[*]}"; exit 0; fi
  run "${cmd[@]}"
else echo "tests-green: no test runner detected in $PWD" >&2; exit 0; fi
[ $rc -eq 0 ] && {
  n=$(grep -Eo '[0-9]+ tests? (passed|run)|Ran [0-9]+ tests?' "$out" | grep -Eo '[0-9]+' | tail -1)
  n=${n:-$(grep -Eo '[0-9]+ passed' "$out" | grep -Eo '[0-9]+' | tail -1)}; n=${n:--}
  elapsed=$(( $(date +%s) - started )); sha=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$sha" ] || sha=-------
  printf 'tests-green: OK %s %s %ss\n' "$n" "$sha" "$elapsed" >&2
  rm -f "$out"; exit 0
}
fail=$(grep -E 'FAIL|ERROR|Error|error TS|✗|✕|AssertionError|assert |Traceback' "$out" | grep -v '^## ' | head -40)
mkdir -p "$root/.orchestrator/runs/tests"
log="$root/.orchestrator/runs/tests/$task-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log"
cp "$out" "$log"
{ echo "tests-green: FAILED. Failures only:"; printf '%s\n' "${fail:-$(tail -40 "$out")}"; echo "$log"; } >&2
rm -f "$out"; exit 2
